events.title: Synchrony Financial stock holds firm after earnings beat
events.summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) reported a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat with $2.59 EPS, surpassing consensus estimates by $0.45. Despite matching revenue estimates at $3.72 billion, the company maintains its FY 2026 EPS guidance of $9.25-$9.50. The stock opened at $79.53, trading above its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, and institutional investors like Northwestern Mutual and Korea Investment CORP have increased their holdings.

articles.headline: Synchrony Financial stock holds firm after earnings beat

events.title: Weekly Recap: Neos Investments acquisition and LCN Capital Partners deal
events.summary: Goldman Sachs (GS) is significantly expanding its asset management sector with two major acquisitions: Neos Investments for up to $2.25 billion and LCN Capital Partners for up to $410 million. These deals will boost GS's ETF and AUM exposure, especially as ETF trading surges and the firm diversifies its private-market and crypto ETF holdings. The article also highlights GS's substantial XRP ETF holdings and its role in a new $2 billion private-market investment vehicle.

articles.headline: Weekly Recap: Neos Investments acquisition and LCN Capital Partners deal

events.title: Martin Marietta completes Lhoist North America acquisition By Investing.com
events.summary: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. (NYSE:MLM) has finalized its acquisition of Lhoist North America, a move that significantly expands its Specialties platform. This transaction adds over 2 billion tons of limestone reserves to Martin Marietta's portfolio, enhancing the company's scale and resilience. Martin Marietta plans to issue updated financial guidance for full-year 2026 when it releases its third-quarter results.

articles.headline: Martin Marietta completes Lhoist North America acquisition By Investing.com
Martin Marietta Completes Lhoist North America Combination, Expanding Specialties Platform

events.title: Sysco stock holds firm as earnings beat and guidance stay high
events.summary: Sysco Corp. (US8718291078) reported an earnings beat with EPS of $1.53, exceeding estimates, and revenues of $22.12 billion, above the $21.95 billion estimate. The company provided optimistic FY 2027 EPS guidance of $5.025 to $5.117, signaling continued investor engagement despite the stock trading below its 52-week high. Sysco's broad customer base and strong financials, including a 2.08% net margin and 95.05% return on equity, suggest a stable profit-rich foodservice distribution business.

articles.headline: Sysco stock holds firm as earnings beat and guidance stay high

events.title: Tesla Controls 59% of the U.S. EV Market -- Its Highest Share Since 2023
events.summary: Tesla's U.S. EV market share has increased to 59%, a level not seen since 2023, despite a 25% stock drop this year. While the company's revenue grew, profitability decreased due to significant investments in AI, Optimus, and robotaxis, leading to negative free cash flow. This creates volatility for investors, balancing a strong core business against speculative ancillary projects.

articles.headline: Tesla Controls 59% of the U.S. EV Market -- Its Highest Share Since 2023

events.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) sees Liberty Broadband unwind stake in merger deal
events.summary: Liberty Broadband Corporation has divested its entire stake in Charter Communications (CHTR) following a merger agreement and combination completed on August 19, 2026. This action, detailed in an amended Schedule 13D filing, signifies Liberty Broadband's exit as a beneficial owner, now holding 0% of Charter's Class A common stock. Prior to the final disposition, Liberty Broadband sold shares back to Charter on two occasions in July and August 2026 for cash.

articles.headline: Charter Communications (CHTR) sees Liberty Broadband unwind stake in merger deal

events.title: Boeing engineers, technical workers reject contract offer
events.summary: Boeing engineers and technical workers have rejected a four-year contract offer from the company, union officials announced. The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA), representing 17,000 members, also voted to authorize a strike if a new agreement isn't reached by October. Key sticking points include the proposed wage increases, which are capped at 3% and tied to inflation and individual performance, a figure several members believe will not keep pace with the rising Consumer Price Index in their primary work area.

articles.headline: Boeing engineers, technical workers reject contract offer

events.title: Roku holders to own 27% of Fox Corp (NASDAQ: FOX) after merger
events.summary: Fox Corp (NASDAQ: FOX) has filed an amended S-4 form detailing its acquisition of Roku, Inc. Roku stockholders will receive 0.9693 shares of FOX Class A Common Stock plus $96.00 in cash per share. This merger is expected to result in former Roku stockholders owning approximately 27% of outstanding FOX common stock.

articles.headline: Roku holders to own 27% of Fox Corp (NASDAQ: FOX) after merger

events.title: PPL stock slips after an August 7 earnings miss
events.summary: PPL stock slipped after reporting Q2 EPS of $0.33, missing the $0.34 forecast, despite revenue reaching $2.11 billion and the company maintaining its fiscal 2026 EPS guidance. Analysts remain constructive with a $42 price target, and PPL declared a steady quarterly dividend of $0.285 a share, reinforcing its defensive utility profile. The stock's current price of $34.69 is below its 52-week high but well above its low, with a market value of $26.11 billion.

articles.headline: PPL stock slips after an August 7 earnings miss

events.title: US business activity surges to 52-month high: S&P Global
events.summary: U.S. business activity reached a 52-month high in August, primarily driven by a resurgence in the services sector, according to S&P Global. While manufacturing saw a slowdown due to supply delays, overall business expectations hit a nine-month high, supported by strong business investment and high equity prices. Despite this growth, consumer expectations for business conditions declined, and retail sales fell in July, suggesting a potential reduction in consumer spending in the latter half of 2026.

articles.headline: US business activity surges to 52-month high: S&P Global

events.title: Goldman Sachs Group Inc Stock (GS) Moved Up by 3.73% on Aug 21: Facts Behind the Movement
events.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc (GS) saw its stock rise by 3.73% on August 21, driven by recovering investment banking and capital markets momentum, alongside elevated Treasury yield volatility benefiting its market-making operations. The company's strong fee pipeline, major global advisory roles, and position as a premier global liquidity provider contributed to the positive movement. Despite some technical sell signals and valuation concerns, robust trading revenue expectations and a recovering advisory backlog continue to fuel investor interest.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs Group Inc Stock (GS) Moved Up by 3.73% on Aug 21: Facts Behind the Movement

events.title: Southern Copper Stock Stays Hot After Q2 Earnings Beat
events.summary: Southern Copper Corporation (SCCO) stock surged over 8% following a strong Q2 earnings beat, with EPS nearly doubling and revenue significantly increasing, driven by strong copper demand. Despite a downgrade from CICC due to valuation concerns, the stock demonstrated significant operating leverage against rising copper prices. Traders are closely watching SCCO, balancing its strong fundamentals and momentum with the cautious analyst rating.

articles.headline: Southern Copper Stock Stays Hot After Q2 Earnings Beat

events.title: EQT Corp. stock holds in the low $50s as Q2 2026 earnings miss consensus
events.summary: EQT Corp. (EQT) stock is trading in the low $50s after reporting Q2 2026 earnings and revenue that missed consensus estimates. The company's adjusted earnings per share declined by 13.3% year-over-year to $0.39, missing the $0.41 consensus, while revenue dropped 29.2% to $1.81 billion, falling short of the $1.84 billion estimate. This performance was attributed to lower realized natural gas prices despite an 11.7% increase in sales volumes, highlighting the company's sensitivity to commodity price fluctuations.

articles.headline: EQT Corp. stock holds in the low $50s as Q2 2026 earnings miss consensus
